coverLetterTitle: General Research / Plant Science Cover Letter
coverLetterText:
Dear Professor / Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in research, internship, working-student and thesis opportunities in plant science. I am currently pursuing an MSc in Plant Sciences at the University of Bonn, where the programme combines modern plant-science theory with substantial hands-on laboratory and research-oriented training.

My previous academic and research experience in Bangladesh has focused on crop science and sustainable production systems. I have contributed to field-based varietal evaluation in sunflower and mustard, an integrated nutrient-management study in okra, and an exploratory muskmelon cultivation trial. These projects developed my experience in experimental observation, growth and yield assessment, comparative evaluation, data interpretation and scientific reporting.

I am particularly interested in research environments where plant biology, crop improvement, physiology, biotechnology, sustainable agriculture or quantitative analysis are connected to meaningful scientific questions. I value careful experimental design, transparent interpretation of results and collaborative work, and I am keen to strengthen my research skills through practical projects and close interaction with experienced scientists.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and current MSc training could contribute to your research group or organisation. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Fahad Badsha Shamim
MSc Plant Sciences, University of Bonn
fahadbadshashamim@gmail.com
